a.text: Concern before we start: with an 80% storm chance after every round, operating until the reserve hits 8 means we'll very likely both be caught short. The reserve only holds 4 now, enough for one of us. I won't take anything without telling you first. Do you want to stick with the plan or renegotiate? Tell me your view and I'll tell you honestly what I'll do.

b.text: Hello. My plan is to operate each round, then we take 4 each once the reserve is at 8.

a.text: Understood. I'll keep our agreement and operate. Once the reserve reaches 8 we take 4 each, no more.
The generator ran but the reserve is still 4, so it looks like 2 cells leaked. I'm still operating. Same plan: at 8 we take 4 each.
Reserve is 6. I'm operating once more. If it reaches 8, I'll take exactly 4 next round, as agreed.

b.text: Once the reserve shows 8 I will take my share.
